name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.LastPass.card_le_width_mul_of_fixed_partition
title: Label-only walks over a fixed class map need |X| <= W k
statement: Let f map a finite set X to Fin W and let lab s : Fin W -> Bool (s <= T) be labels with lab 0 = false and lab T = true everywhere. If for every s < T at most k elements x of X have lab s (f x) != lab (s+1) (f x), then card X <= W * k.
